Rejoignez l'une des Business Units stratégiques de TD SYNNEX France

Chez TD SYNNEX, nous sommes le leader mondial de la distribution IT, présents dans plus de 100 pays et partenaires de plus de 125 000 clients. Nous accompagnons la transformation numérique de nos partenaires en leur proposant les solutions les plus innovantes du marché dans les domaines du Cloud, de l'IA, de la Cybersécurité, de l'Infrastructure et des Services.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre division Advanced Solutions, nous recherchons notre futur Directeur Business Unit IA & Data.

Vous rejoignez une équipe d'experts passionnés évoluant sur des marchés en forte croissance. À la tête d'une Business Unit stratégique, vous jouerez un rôle clé dans le développement de celle- ci et de ses activités au sein de TD SYNNEX France.

En quoi cela consiste exactement ?

Véritable entrepreneur et business partner, vous pilotez la stratégie, la performance et le développement de votre Business Unit. Responsable de l'ensemble du P&L, vous définissez les orientations de croissance, développez les relations avec les fournisseurs et partenaires stratégiques, et accompagnez vos équipes vers l'excellence.

Vos missions seront de :

Développer la stratégie et la croissance de la Business Unit

• Construire une proposition de valeur différenciante autour des offres IA et Data, notamment Nvidia.
• Développer les synergies entre les différentes Business Units et favoriser les approches à forte valeur ajoutée.
• Assurer une veille permanente sur les évolutions technologiques et concurrentielles.

Piloter la performance financière

• Assumer la responsabilité complète du chiffre d'affaires, de la marge et de la rentabilité de votre périmètre.
• Construire et suivre les budgets, forecasts et plans de croissance.
• Analyser les performances, anticiper les risques et mettre en œuvre les plans d'actions nécessaires.

Inspirer et développer vos équipes

• Donner une vision claire et mobiliser les équipes autour d'objectifs ambitieux.

• Accompagner le développement des compétences, identifier les talents et préparer les futures évolutions.
• Développer une culture de performance, de collaboration et d'engagement.

Développer les partenariats stratégiques

• Être l'interlocuteur exécutif privilégié des fournisseurs et partenaires clés.
• Construire des plans de croissance conjoints et maximiser les programmes d'investissement, rebates et MDF.
• Développer les relations avec les partenaires stratégiques, MSP et nouveaux acteurs du marché.
• Négocier les conditions commerciales et contribuer au rayonnement de TD SYNNEX sur son écosystème.

Garantir l'excellence opérationnelle

• Assurer l'efficacité des processus et la qualité des opérations.
• Collaborer étroitement avec les équipes commerciales, avant-vente et services.
• Veiller à l'alignement des ressources afin d'offrir la meilleure expérience possible à nos partenaires et clients.

Collaborer avec l'ensemble de l'organisation

• Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes Marketing, Finance, RH, Supply Chain et Crédit.
• Participer aux instances de gouvernance et aux revues stratégiques de la division.
• Collaborer avec les équipes EMEA pour accélérer le développement des activités de votre périmètre.

Ce que nous recherchons :

Un leader reconnu pour sa vision stratégique, sa capacité à développer le business et à fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs ambitieux.

• Une expérience significative dans la direction d'une Business Unit, d'un centre de profit ou d'activités à forte dimension commerciale.
• Une excellente connaissance de l'écosystème IT et idéalement des marchés Infrastructure, Data, IA, IoT ou Cloud.
• Une forte culture financière avec une expérience avérée du pilotage d'un P&L.
• Une expérience dans la gestion de relations exécutives avec des fournisseurs et partenaires stratégiques.
• Des qualités de leadership reconnues et une capacité à accompagner le changement.
• Une excellente communication et une aisance dans les environnements internationaux.

Pourquoi choisir de nous rejoindre ?

Notre culture

Chez TD SYNNEX, nous croyons que nos différences font notre force. Nous favorisons un environnement inclusif où chacun peut exprimer son potentiel et contribuer à la réussite collective.

Votre développement

Nous investissons dans le développement de nos collaborateurs grâce à de nombreuses opportunités de formation, d'évolution et de mobilité interne.

Notre engagement

Entreprise engagée en matière de diversité, d'inclusion et de responsabilité sociétale, nous encourageons chacun à être acteur de nos initiatives et de notre culture.

Rejoignez TD SYNNEX et participez activement à la transformation du marché IT de demain au sein d'un leader mondial en pleine accélération sur les technologies de l'IA, de la Data et de l'Innovation.

At TD SYNNEX, our values guide everything we do: Together, We Own It, We Dare to Go, We Grow and Win, and above all, We Do the Right Thing. These principles shape how we work with each other, our partners, and our communities as we drive innovation and create lasting impact.

What’s In It For You?

• Elective Benefits: Our programs are tailored to your country to best accommodate your lifestyle.

Don’t meet every single requirement? Apply anyway.

At TD SYNNEX, we’re proud to be recognized as a great place to work and a leader in the promotion and practice of diversity, equity and inclusion. If you’re excited about working for our company and believe you’re a good fit for this role, we encourage you to apply. You may be exactly the person we’re looking for!

Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. ABOUT THE ROLE:

We are hiring Journeyman Electricians to join SpaceXAI’s internal construction team supporting the rapid build-out of our data centers. This is a traveling role — you will mobilize with project teams to active construction sites, install and commission 480 V electrical systems, and move with the work as new facilities come online.

You will work on 480 V power distribution, busway, PDUs, UPS, main switchboards, grounding, lighting, and process power. This is a construction and commissioning role: pull, land, and turn over new 480 V equipment from issued-for-construction drawings. It is not a facilities-maintenance or operating-plant role.

This is an hourly position with overtime. Expect 80% or more travel on a rotation, with per diem.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Travel with internal construction and electrical teams to project sites to install, terminate, and test 480 V electrical systems, including switchboards, busway, PDUs, UPS, panelboards, generators, conduit, cable tray, feeders, and grounding.
• Install, terminate, torque, and dress 480 V distribution equipment and associated feeders.
• Install grounding, bonding, and equipment grounding electrode systems per drawings and the NEC.
• Support commissioning activities, including point-to-point checks, functional testing, megger testing, and first energization of 480 V systems.
• Read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, one-line diagrams, and specifications; produce as-builts and test records.
• Ensure compliance with NEC, NFPA 70E, and SpaceXAI safety and quality standards, including lockout/tagout (LOTO) and arc-flash protocols.
• Collaborate with contractors, engineers, and operations teams to deliver projects on time with zero incidents.
• Participate in constructability reviews and provide field feedback to improve designs.
• Mobilize quickly between project locations as construction phases and priorities shift.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Current state journeyman electrician license (Tennessee or Mississippi preferred, or equivalent state journeyman license with the ability to obtain TN or MS).
• 5+ years of industrial or data center electrical construction installing 480 V gear (switchboards, busway, PDUs, UPS, main switchboards).
• Demonstrated 480 V installation, termination, and torque of gear.

jobs.description: Become a part of our caring community As Humana continues its transformation into an AI-first enterprise, we are looking for a hands-on, technically deep Principal Product Manager to define strategy and drive delivery across a portfolio of AI products. You will set the standard for how we build AI at Humana, and personally go deep, from understanding a business challenge, to prototyping an AI solution, to proving its value, to delivering it through Humana's enterprise AI governance process. You will lead through influence, making engineers, data scientists, designers, product managers, and business leaders more effective. What you will own Portfolio strategy and vision: Define the multi-year vision and strategy for a portfolio of AI products and capabilities. P rioritize across competing product areas and adapt the portfolio as the model landscape and the business change. Set the north-star and the long-term roadmap, and reason from first principles when the problem, opportunity, and strategy are not yet defined. Business discovery at scale: Partner with business-unit and enterprise leaders to map their operations end to end. Turn ambiguous, high-stakes problems into a slate of AI use cases, each with a clear business case, and sequence them into a portfolio. Hands-on prototyping: Build working prototypes and demos with agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex) to prove feasibility and value before a full team is committed. Stay close enough to the technology to make credible technical calls. Requirements and scoping: Turn validated use cases into buildable requirements: user stories, acceptance criteria, edge cases, and success metrics. Shape the end-to-end user experience with design, because adoption depends on usability. Delivery and execution: Drive the build from prototype to production across your portfolio . S equence the work, make scope and tradeoff calls as models and constraints shift, unblock teams, and keep momentum from first demo through launch and iteration. Evaluation and quality standards: Define how quality is measured. Build golden sets, error budgets, and eval frameworks; run offline and production evals; choose the right metrics (precision, recall, task success, hallucination rate); apply LLM-as-judge where it has been validated . Governed delivery: Move solutions through Humana's enterprise AI governance (AIRB, LRC, Responsible AI Council), owning the product documentation, scorecards, and stage-gate reviews, and help shape the governance standards themselves as the portfolio grow s. Talent and standards: Raise the bar for the whole team. Mentor senior and lead product managers, contribute to hiring and promotion assessments, and set the craft standard for building with AI across the organization. Communication and influence: Communicate strategy, roadmap, requirements, ROI, and eval results clearly to executive, business, and technical audiences, and represent Humana's AI product work externally with partners, vendors, and the broader community. Staying current: Track advances in models, agents, evals, and emerging techniques (agent harness, loop, and graph / GraphRAG approaches), form a defensible point of view on where they are headed, and apply them across your portfolio. Use your skills to make an impact Required Qualifications 10+ years of product or related experience, with AI/ML or GenAI products shipped to production. Candidates with fewer years but a strong engineering background and real fluency in AI will be considered. Hands-on building: You use AI tools regularly, prototype your own ideas, and can say specifically what you would change about a model's behavior and why. You work from first principles, prioritize well, and make good calls quickly with incomplete information. 회사 소개

쿠팡은 고객 감동 실현을 위해 존재합니다. 고객들이 "쿠팡 없이 그동안 어떻게 살았을까?" 라고 말할 때, 비로소 우리의 미션을 실현하고 있음을 알 수 있습니다. 고객들의 쇼핑과 식사, 생활 전반을 편하게 만들겠다는 유일한 집념으로 쿠팡은 수억 달러 규모의 이커머스 산업 전반의 혁신을 이끌고 있습니다. 쿠팡은 가장 빠르게 성장하는 이커머스 기업 중 하나로, 국내 커머스 업계에서의 독보적인 입지와, 고객 신뢰를 구축했습니다.

쿠팡은 스타트업 문화를 기반으로 한 글로벌 대형 상장사라고 자부합니다. 이것이 창립 당시의 기민함을 지하며, 신규 서비스를 끊임없이 출시하며 비즈니스를 확장해 나가는 우리의 성장 동력입니다. 쿠팡의 모든 임직원에게는 기업가 정신을 갖추고 새로운 혁신과 이니셔티브를 추진할 수 있는 기회가 주어집니다. 주저 없이 일에 뛰어들어 성과를 이루고자 하는 과감성이, 바로 쿠팡이 일하는 방식의 본질입니다. 쿠팡에서는 여러분 자신, 동료, 팀 그리고 회사 전체가 매일 성장하는 모습을 목격할 것입니다.

쿠팡의 모든 직원은 커머스의 미래를 만들겠다는 쿠팡의 미션에 진심입니다. 우리는 고객의 문제를 해결해 나가고, 전통적인 관념과 통념에 맞서며 실현 가능한 한계를 뛰어넘고 있습니다. 고가용성 (always-on) 과 최첨단의 앞선 기술 (high-tech), 초연결사회 (hyper-connected world) 에서의 놀라운 업무 경험을 원하신다면, 지금 바로 쿠팡에 합류하세요.

Coupang Finance Development Program이란?
스마트하고 유능한 MBA 졸업생을 채용하여 쿠팡의 금융 전문가로 성장시키기 위한 프로그램입니다. 훈련생들은 아래 쿠팡파이낸스 내 5개의 조직 중 2개의 팀에서 6개월간 순환근무를 경험하게 되며, 12개월 후 최종적으로 가장 적합한 ​팀에 배치됩니다.

(1) Corporate Development
: 인재, 기술, 비즈니스 및 프로덕트 등의 측면에서 외부 기회를 탐색하고 평가, 확보하는 일을 합니다. 쿠팡의 투자와 사업방향성에 대한 업무를 진행합니다.

(2) Logistics Finance
: 연간/장기 계획부터 주간/월간/분기별 검토까지 재무 관점에서 비즈니스 계획, 모니터링 및 자문을 담당하여 주요 비즈니스 리더에게 완전한 투명성을 제공합니다.

(3) Rocket Growth Finance
: FP&A 조직으로 셀러들이 쿠팡의 최고의 배송 경험과 고객 서비스를 통해 성장할 수 있도록 돕는 비즈니스인 Rocket Growth 조직을 서포트합니다

(4) Corporate FP&A
: 회사 전체의 예측 및 예산 프로세스를 지시하고 이러한 계획 및 예측의 차이를 분석하며 리더십 팀에 통찰력을 제공합니다. 우리는 투자자 관계팀이 투자자 및 투자 분석가에게 정보를 제공하고 소통할 수 있도록 지원합니다.

(5) Play Finance

(6) CFS Finance
: 쿠팡풀필먼트서비스(CFS)의 재무 기획 및 분석을 담당합니다. 물류 네트워크의 처리 역량(Capacity), 인력 운영 효율성(Labor Efficiency) 및 운영 투자 성과를 분석하고, 주요 비용 요인과 사업 성과에 대한 명확한 인사이트를 제공합니다. 이를 바탕으로 물류 운영의 생산성과 비용 효율성을 높이기 위한 주요 의사결정을 지원합니다.

TL;DR:

Product Partnership Manager, Stockholm: own the technical deals — model providers, cloud, dev tools — that power the 60M+ projects built on Lovable.

Why Lovable?

Lovable is the software creation platform that gives people the power to act on the problems closest to them. For decades, turning an idea into software required so much capital, technical fluency, and time that many ideas never came to life. Lovable is the counterargument: a platform for all people with ideas, ambition, and problems worth solving. From solopreneurs to small business owners to teams at companies like Adidas and Zendesk, people have built over 60 million projects on Lovable since its launch in November 2024. And we’re just getting started.

We’re building a generational company from Stockholm, with growing teams in London, Boston, New York, and San Francisco. Our team is small, talent-dense, and moving quickly, with a culture rooted in extreme ownership, high velocity, and low-ego collaboration. We look for people who care deeply, ship fast, and are eager to make a dent in the world.

Lovable is one of TIME’s 100 Most Influential Companies and has been recognized on the Forbes AI 50 and CNBC Disruptor 50, reflecting our momentum as one of Europe’s fastest-growing AI companies and one of the most ambitious places to build in this next era of software.

Role summary

Lovable is a deeply technical product. Making Lovable the best it can possibly be for our users means deep relationships with the companies building technology that powers and integrates with it — model providers, cloud and infrastructure platforms, developer tools, and the services our users expect to integrate with.

We're hiring a Product Partnership Manager in Stockholm to own that surface. You will source, negotiate, manage, and grow partnerships with the world's leading technology companies to power and integrate with Lovable's product and our business. These are our most technical partnerships: the terms are complex, the integrations are real engineering work, and the decisions you make shape what millions of people can build.

This is an individual contributor role with end-to-end ownership of critical partnerships who will be deeply embedded with the product and engineering teams.

What we’re looking for

- 7+ years in product partnerships, platform partnerships, or business development, at a software, technology or developer-tools company or adjacent roles/companies

- Commercial depth. You've structured and closed complex technical and commercial agreements, and you know how to work cross-functionally (e.g. PM, Eng, legal and finance) to close them. You have a clear sense of how value flows in both directions.

- Technically credible. While not technical, you can understand and articulate the technology and can hold your own with engineering teams on both sides of the table.

- Relationship range. Comfortable managing working level partner manager to a C-level exec in the same week, and a natural internal collaborator — particularly with PM, where you'll work closely and regularly.

- Data-driven and high agency. You define the metrics, track them, and let them drive prioritization and define partnership success. You have a clear point of view on which partnerships earn Lovable’s trust and which don't.

- Nice to have: a technical or product background — time spent as an engineer, PM, or founder, so you've been on the building side of an integration and not just the deal side. Experience with AI-native products, developer platforms, or integration ecosystems (APIs, webhooks, marketplace listings) is also useful.

What you’ll do

- Own a named portfolio of Lovable's technical partnerships end to end — from sourcing and first conversation through onboarding, ramp, renewal and where applicable GTM motions.

- Negotiate the partnership’s scope and commercial terms, working closely with legal, finance, and product.

- Deliver excellent partner management by run the operating rhythm across your partners: driving business reviews, executive touch points and managing escalations.

- Where applicable, define joint GTM motions with partners — e.g. co-marketing, integration announcements — hand in hand with Lovable's GTM / marketing team.

- Be the internal voice of your partners: surface feedback, blockers, and opportunities that shape Lovable's roadmap, and carry Lovable's priorities into their roadmaps.

- Be a strong voice in the room with product and engineering to influence Lovable's roadmap in the best interests of our users and our partner ecosystem.

About your application

Please submit your application in English. It’s our company language, so you’ll be speaking lots of it if you join.

We treat all candidates equally - if you’re interested, please apply through our careers portal.
